first.rationale: Onboarding completion is currently down 4%, and two inherited findings independently link simpler onboarding or signup to better completion, time-to-value, adoption, and activation. This directly addresses a current funnel deterioration without the known 30-day retention harm associated with promotional pricing. Verification should confirm durability, segment fit, and downstream qualified-revenue effects before committing the experiment.

final.rationale: Run a guarded simplification experiment only for SMB accounts identified as simple workspaces, while excluding complex-workspace accounts and preserving their setup steps. This directly addresses declining onboarding completion and activation, has demonstrated qualified-revenue lift in SMBs, and avoids the documented 60-day churn increase when complex accounts receive shortened onboarding. Measure qualified revenue and retention, not completion alone; effects outside SMB and simple-workspace cohorts remain unproven.
